translations.zh: 荊王劉賈，高帝從父兄也，不知其初起時。
translations.literal: King Liu Jia of Jing was Gaozu's patrilateral cousin; nothing is known of his earliest career.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Jia, king of Jing, was Gaozu's patrilateral cousin; nothing is known of his earliest career.

translations.zh: 漢元年，還定三秦，賈為將軍，定塞地，從東擊項籍。
translations.literal: In Han year 1, when the Three Qins were pacified, Jia served as a general, secured Sai territory, and marched east against Xiang Ji.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Han, after the pacification of the Three Qins, Liu Jia served as a general, secured Sai territory, and marched east against Xiang Yu.
